en: A black-and-white panoramic view of a small mountain town nestled in a valley, surrounded by rolling hills and distant alpine peaks. The town consists of compact houses with light-colored walls and sloped roofs, a central church or clock-tower rising above the buildings, and a few standalone villas in the foreground beside a wooden fence and tree. Handwritten in ink across the sky area is a date, and printed text along the bottom identifies the location as Cavalese in Val di Fiemme at 993 meters altitude.
